verdict.rationale: Bolt.new documents a 'multiplayer mode' letting collaborators prompt and edit the same project simultaneously in real time, which directly supports shared team workspaces, but this requires the project visibility to be set to public, and there is no independent/hands-on evidence confirming how well this collaboration works in practice. missing for 10: independent corroboration of multiplayer mode in use, clarity on private-project team collaboration/permissions beyond the public/private toggle.
